decisions.reason: The LED track spotlight builds directly on the firm's core track and modular lighting know-how and kept its own page for two years, so management can read its results and refine it.
The LED ceiling luminaire is closely tied to the established luminaire portfolio and has stayed prominently presented since 2023, which signals stable integration into the range.
The flexible LED spotlight extends the firm's existing spotlight expertise, and as a recent launch with its own page it deserves time for learning and adjustment.
The multi-outlet ceiling canopy is a system accessory that fits the modular lighting knowledge base and supports the sales of pendant configurations.
The low-voltage canopy complements the firm's established low-voltage system competence, though its narrower niche makes it slightly more exposed.
The round glass track luminaires fit the track system knowledge, but being only mentioned rather than featured suggests weaker commitment and a higher risk of being pruned.
